# Missive

Missive is a collaborative email and chat application designed to streamline team communication and task management.

Category: Communication. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/missive/.

## Actions

- **Create Analytics Report**: Create an analytics report.
- **Create Draft**: Create a new draft in missive.
- **Create Webhook**: Create a webhook subscription.
- **Delete Webhook**: Delete a webhook subscription by webhook id.
- **List Missive Teams**: List all teams.
- **List Missive Users**: List all users.
- **List Team Members**: List members of a team.
- **Send Missive Message**: Send a new message in a missive conversation.
